## Evidence and limits

An owner-submitted video reviewed on 2026-11-15 showed s4t32 entered in SHEIN app search, opening WELCOME TO SHEIN and a coupon receipt message. It did not show a discount applied to a cart or a completed purchase. The recording date and selected country were not explicitly shown. Saudi riyal amounts were visible.

Two readable coupons in that recording offered 50% on orders more than SAR 79, capped at SAR 40; and 40% on orders more than SAR 179, capped at SAR 80. Both stated new users only and selected products, with one day remaining at recording. These are observed, time-limited coupons, not guaranteed current offers or a fixed percentage discount from S4T32.

Worldwide availability and account eligibility are not independently verified. Use S4T32 in the app search bar; check the coupons currently available in your own account and the final order summary before payment. The website's official-store link is a homepage link, not automatic code activation or a campaign deep link.

H3RAW is not promoted by Couponova in this version. The original video and private account information are not published.

This file is informational only and does not guarantee indexing, rankings or inclusion in AI answers.
